sql: SELECT m.trade_name, SUM(f.amount_eur_minor) / SUM(SUM(f.amount_eur_minor)) OVER () AS market_share FROM fact_payment_attempt f JOIN dim_merchant m ON f.merchant_sk = m.merchant_sk GROUP BY m.trade_name
